name: Tribal Colors
summary: A skeleton’s war paint wrap may hold meaning for the Darkspear tribe. You take it to someone who can read its signs.

sections.title: The Marked Wrap
sections.body: A skeleton still grips a throwing spear, and its remains bear the signs of a troll headhunter. Beside it lies a leather wrap marked with troll writing and Darkspear face tints. You carry the wrap to someone who may know its meaning.

sections.title: Old Colors
sections.body: The Darkspear battle wrap was kept tightly rolled so its colors would not run together. Darkspear warriors paint themselves before battle, following an old custom meant to stir their spirits and keep their strength flowing.

faq.q: What is the War Paint Wrap?
faq.answer: It is a leather wrap marked with troll writing and smudges of Darkspear face tints, used to apply war paint.
A member of the Darkspear tribe may recognize the writing on the wrap.
Darkspear warriors paint themselves before battle to stir their spirits and keep their strength flowing.

faq.q: Why is the wrap rolled tight?
faq.answer: It is rolled tightly to keep the colors from running together.

angles.text: As a troll, you can bring the marked wrap to someone who may recognize the Darkspear writing.
